title: Resolution of the cosmological constant problem by unimodular gravity and signature reversal symmetry
summary: The (old) cosmological constant problem consists of two different problems. The first is the huge discrepancy between the value of the cosmological constant deduced from observations and its value expected from cosmological constant-like theoretical contributions (such as vacuum expectation value of Higgs potential). The second problem is why the value of the cosmological constant has its particular (very small) value.
